decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system remains a specialist, certification-heavy offer with long qualification cycles, so a large German industrial lighting firm would usually retain it rather than withdraw it quickly.
The spring-balanced desk lamp is less central than integrated building lighting but still supports the firm's ergonomic workplace portfolio, making retention more likely than discontinuation.
This general interior lighting luminaire sits squarely in the firm's mainstream building-lighting business, so it is likely to stay in the range after only a short time on the market.
As a flagship pendant luminaire tied to the firm's stated direction, it would be unusual for management to remove it so soon unless it clearly failed.
The marine HMI searchlight serves a known niche, but HMI technology is increasingly misaligned with the firm's LED- and sustainability-led strategy, making phase-out within the next year plausible.
The marine searchlight still fits the firm's demanding-environment and transport-related offering, so it is more likely to be maintained than cut.
